summary: @or-sdk/accounts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-property maps typical of javascript-obfuscator output) and, when a local `bun` binary is not found, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip into a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line bundle with a shuffled string-array constant, hex-mangled identifiers, and a `@bun @bun-cjs` header; its behavior is not documented and cannot be determined from the source. The payload runs under Bun rather than Node, bypassing tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code, and it executes unconditionally on `npm install` before any consumer code runs. The package presents itself as an accounts SDK, a purpose that does not require pulling a second language runtime at install to run an obfuscated bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
